impact_summary.value: 완제품 출하시험, 원료 입고시험 및 안정성 자료가 충분히 입증되지 않아 제품이 규격을 충족하는지 확인할 과학적 근거가 부족합니다. 제조기록 미비로 제조 과정의 추적성과 재현성도 저해됩니다.

evidence.quote: Without adequate testing, there is no scientific evidence to assure that your drug products conform to appropriate specifications before release.
Having incomplete records deprives you of traceability of actions necessary for investigational purposes.

affected_work.value: Everlaan Organics, Inc. dba Maple Organics의 미국 유통 대상 OTC 의약품 제조·출하, 원료 관리, 안정성 관리, 제조기록 및 품질관리 업무입니다.

evidence.quote: Your facility was registered with the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as a manufacturer of over-the-counter (OTC) drug products.
Based on the records and information you provided, you did not demonstrate that you adequately test your OTC finished drug products prior to release for distribution to the United States.

recommendation.value: FDA는 배치별 출하 전 화학·미생물 규격과 시험법, 유효기간 내 미국 유통 배치의 보관검체 시험 계획·일정·결과를 제출하고, 품질 미달 시 신속한 시정조치와 고객 통지·회수를 하라고 요구합니다. 입고 원료별 시험 및 공급업체 성적서 신뢰성 검증 자료, 안정성 프로그램 평가·시정예방 계획, 제조기록과 품질관리단위 개선 자료도 제출하도록 요구합니다. 미국 시장 제조를 재개하려는 경우 자격 있는 컨설턴트의 참여를 권고합니다.

evidence.quote: In response to this letter, provide: A list of chemical and microbial specifications, including adequate test methods, used to analyze each batch of your drug products before a batch disposition decision.

o An action plan and timelines for conducting full chemical and microbiological testing of retain samples to determine the quality of all batches of drug product distributed to the United States that are within expiry as of the date of this letter.

Based upon the nature of the violations we identified at your firm, you should engage a consultant qualified as set forth in 21 CFR 211.34 to evaluate your operations and to assist your firm in meeting CGMP requirements if your firm intends to resume manufacturing drugs for the U.S. market.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.
